linear-functions.title: What the slope means — rise over run

inputs.title: Slope = rise ÷ run
inputs.content: Pick any two points on the line.|**Run** — how far you move across in $x$.|**Rise** — how far you move up in $y$.|The slope is $m = \dfrac{\text{rise}}{\text{run}}$ — and it is the same wherever you measure it.

inputs.title: Here
inputs.content: $m = \dfrac{[rise]len}{[run]len} = {{ [rise]len / [run]len }}$ — the line climbs ${{ [rise]len / [run]len }}$ for every $1$ across.
